ruleDefinitions.name: Binary Proxy Execution Via Dotnet-Trace.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects commandline arguments for executing a child process via dotnet-trace.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\dotnet\\-trace\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "dotnet\-trace\.dll") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*collect.*")))
